Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Minor Innate Technique. Example technique for sorcerers and NPCs (GM approval).

When you reduce a cursed spirit, shikigami, or cursed corpse to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to spend 3 cursed energy to devour its corpse. For 1 hour, you gain a feature, action, movement, resistance, immunity, sense, AC or other statistic from the dead creature’s statblock. You can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to steal an additional statistic and can do so up to your proficiency bonus. You can have stolen statistics from a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier active at once.
